Celebrating World Quality Week with PRI
This week, we celebrate the people and organizations turning quality into meaningful improvement to protect what matters.
Our commitment to continuous improvement has shaped an industry that values not only technical precision but also transparency and accountability.

As we look to the future, we will continue to work to maintain the trust and integrity in critical manufacturing processes that help power the global economy. This legacy of excellence continues to inspire industry-wide progress, setting the stage for even greater achievements in the decades to come.

Since being established as a not-for-profit trade association in 1990, PRI℠ has become the global authority in facilitating industry-managed programs and administering critical process accreditation programs as well as developing web based audit management software. Remaining cost-effective while continually identifying new ways to add value for our customers is our priority.

PRI Protects What Matters®
To be the preeminent partner that drives flawless performance in high-stakes industries.

The Nadcap® program is the premier program for accrediting critical processes in the aerospace and defense industries, Nadcap focuses on standardizing approaches to quality assurance and promoting continuous improvement. This program is essential for suppliers seeking to demonstrate their commitment to excellence.

The MedAccred® program is specifically tailored for the medical devices industry, MedAccred® accredits critical processes that impact patient safety and product quality. This program is vital for suppliers to stand out in the highly regulated medical sector.

PRI Certification℠ is renowned for our accreditation and certification services. The PRI Certification℠ service ensures the highest standards in quality management systems. We specialize in industries such as aerospace, automotive, environmental, and medical devices, providing ISO certifications and more.

The PRI Training℠ program is our training division offers a wide range of professional development courses designed to enhance skills in quality assurance and industry-specific standards. From specialized workshops to in-depth training programs, we equip professionals with the knowledge to excel in their fields.
PRI Counterfeit Avoidance Accreditation Program℠ (PRI CAAP℠)

PRI Counterfeit Avoidance Accreditation Program℠ (PRI CAAP℠) is a cooperative industry effort to mitigate the risk of introducing counterfeit parts into the supply chain and the cost for compliance throughout the aviation, defense and space industries.

The PRI Qualification℠ program is administered by PRI and is a global system managed by aerospace industry experts that creates aerospace manufacturing personnel qualifications. Through our qualification program, we are empowering all parties to influence and collaborate to protect the future of the industry today.
Transportation & Power Generation (TPG) improves manufacturing process controls and performance and reduces compliance risk in the transportation and power generation industries.

The Performance360℠ service provides customized services that support the optimization and improvement of internal systems, supply chain, and a company’s performance. This is achieved through a focus on the critical manufacturing and quality processes of a company and those of its suppliers.
PRI Qualified Products Listing℠ (PRI QPL℠)

PRI Qualified Products Listing℠ (PRI QPL℠) administers qualified products listing programs on behalf of the US government and global aerospace and ground vehicle industries. We work collaboratively with QPL stakeholders to operate efficiently and effectively for the benefit of all.

The Performance Review Institute (PRI) was set up in Pittsburgh, PA, USA. PRI administers Nadcap – the aerospace critical process, product and systems accreditation program. Nadcap has since become recognized as a key part of the aerospace procurement and risk mitigation activity.

Nadcap was followed by PRI Registrar (now PRI Certification), an ANAB accredited management systems registrar which provides international third-party certifications to standards such as ISO 9001, AS9100 and ISO 14001, among others.
PRI published the first of three QPLs (Qualified Products Listings) and went on to introduce QPLs covering aerospace, and ground vehicle brake lining and gear lubricant.
